Examples.Title: Get Export Types
Examples.Description: Returns the list of all available export types.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using BlockadeLabs;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Request Export
Examples.Description:
Process for tracking export progress is identical to tracking skybox generation by using Pusher, Webhook or API Data pooling.

If the export request has already been completed you will immediately get a response with status=complete and file_url in the response.
Examples.Code:
### Request Export
# @name requestExport
POST {{host}}/api/v1/skybox/export
x-api-key: {{api_key}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "skybox_id": "f87f6a4b3784591795bfed30100a9ef6",
  "type_id": 2,
  "webhook_url": ""
}

## Responses
# 200
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Cancel All Pending Generations
Examples.Description: This request sets the status of all pending generations to abort.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using BlockadeLabs;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Cancel Generation

Examples.Title: Get Skybox Style Families
Examples.Description: Returns the list of predefined styles that can influence the overall aesthetic of your skybox generation, sorted by style family. This route can be used in order to build a menu of styles sorted by family.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using BlockadeLabs;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.
